gen-fs-panchang-lora: Confident and expressive, Panchang draws its letters like cut wire, with plenty of blank space between each stem and curve; Lora follows with a gentler, bookish voice. Its strokes vary just slightly, which makes it comfortable in small doses.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-courier-prime: Pramukh Rounded crowds its glyphs close together, with large lowercase forms and tight ascender clearance. And Courier Prime, a monospace with horizontals as heavy as its verticals, would carry a long page with a steady drafting-pen rhythm.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-esteban: Esteban sets a refined serif whose lowercase looks oversized beside its capitals, and thin parts barely slimmer than the stems. But Pramukh Rounded earns its keep big and short, where its bunched, friendly glyphs can fill the space.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-faustina: Faustina brings a classic, authoritative text serif, with bowls that thin gracefully and capitals only slightly taller than the lowercase. Faustina would carry a long stretch of text with a quiet weight shift, while Pramukh Rounded stays soft and tightly knit above it.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-geist-mono: Pramukh Rounded packs its friendly glyphs tightly, with open bowls and big lowercase forms. Geist Mono answers with fixed-width monospace letters, high-rising lowercase and generous side gaps, and neither font tapers its strokes where they meet or end.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-halant: Halant reads as a traditional, authoritative serif, with a faint thick-thin shift and a towering x-height like a stubby pencil stroke. Yet Pramukh Rounded would feel cramped if made small, since its glyphs already sit bunched tight.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-hedvig-letters: Authoritative describes Hedvig Letters Serif, whose open-ended curves and tall, sturdy lowercase carry a classic serif feel, with stems just heavier than the hairlines. And Pramukh Rounded would hold the page differently over many lines, soft and tightly packed, with barely any taper.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-lisu-bosa: Pramukh Rounded packs friendly, bunched glyphs with open bowls and large lowercase forms, and it keeps its strokes low in contrast. Lisu Bosa, a classic serif, does its best work in tall, sturdy words with counters that spill into the space and a modest thick-thin swing.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-major-mono-dis: Major Mono Display looks like neon glass, with big sidebearings and sweeping curves. Its monospace tubes keep terminals at the width they began, so a long passage would read as sparse and technical beside Pramukh Rounded's tightly bunched, friendly forms.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-marcellus-sc: Dignified and literary, Marcellus SC is a classic serif with gentle modulation, pulled-back terminals and a lowercase of cast-iron stature. Pramukh Rounded sits against it tightly knit and friendly, low in contrast.
